package.verification: Current source and output hashes; independent ZIP decoding and exact bytes. iPhone/Sitecase real-device play is not implied.

mobile.explanation: The initial matrix had one WebKit test-driver coordinate quantization failure: fractional button center 704.8125,254.8125 plus 64px was dispatched at integer 768,254, producing exactly 522.134990687158 world units. The three range tests now drag to radius+2, within the same expanded wheel; the exact range assertions remain. All nine affected browser/skill pairs were rerun. Production package bytes did not change.
mobile.inputScope: Chromium CDP trusted multi-touch; desktop WebKit trusted mouse skill drags. Two WebKit multi-touch cases skipped; physical iPhone input is unverified.

visualReview: Actual rendered hero, target, captions and HUD reviewed at normal and reduced heights, and upper/lower 650-unit previews.
limits: Physical iPhone/Sitecase WebGL, audio, touch feel, performance, background resume and persistent storage still require retesting.
Extreme aim framing beyond the arena background can expose a 30–58px dark margin; control/input checks still pass.
Nova III browser fixtures isolate the guide mechanism and do not prove natural progression or physical phone acceptance.
